entry.description: Escape lone surrogates as `\uXXXX` in `AppenderSkeleton.RenderLoggingEvent`, for every appender that uses it, third-party ones included, and in the categories of `TraceAppender`, `DebugAppender` and `AspNetTraceAppender`. One such character stopped an appender over a `StreamWriter` with the default encoding until the process restarted. Output changes where a lone surrogate used to become `?`, U+FFFD or pass through unchanged, and there is no option to turn it off. The XML layouts keep masking it as `?`. Layouts now receive a wrapping writer, and `WriteLine()` follows the `NewLine` of the application's writer. `TraceAppender` and `DebugAppender` also report a failed flush instead of throwing (ANT-2026-K72QFN2N, fixed by @FreeAndNil in https://github.com/apache/logging-log4net/pull/355[#355])
